title: Akiyama Mizuki — Nightcord at 25:00〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Look at that, Ena uploaded another selfie.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Look at this cute blouse and hat I found!
Hmm, they do look nice on her...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The sleeves are bothering me, though.
And the hat could use some embellishments too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The sleeves should be narrower... And the hat decorated with lace and some pearls...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, this would look much better!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I can cute up that outfit you just posted about!>
There, message sent.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see what she says.
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey there, Ena!
Did you bring the outfit?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Here it is.
Are you sure this is going to work?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The edited photo you sent me looked cute, but can you actually do those modifications in real life?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You don't trust my sewing skills?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Why should I?
Having good taste in fashion doesn't make you a tailor.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Well, I'll show you what I can do!
Come on♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh? Where are we going?
I thought you just wanted me to bring you the clothes?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I wouldn't have called you out all the way here if it was only for that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Come on, it'll be fun. I promise♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here we are!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You brought us to a diner?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's not a diner anymore!
It's been repurposed as a sewing lounge.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A...sewing lounge?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Take a look at the tables!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, they have lots of sewing machines here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. Anyone can use them for free, but you pay for coffee and food.

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
Hello, Mizuki.
You brought a friend today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! Is the machine I normally use free?

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
Yes. That'll be table number two.
Let me know if you need anything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks♪
It's this way, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay.
So you have a specific sewing machine you use?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, because there are all sorts and they're good for different things. The one I like has embroidery settings, like for overlock stitching.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I see now that they do in fact look different. Aw, this one looks adorable. It looks like an antique!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Go ahead and order some nibbles. And cola for me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, let's get everything set up...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow, this lace is lovely!
Is this what you drew in that picture?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, and here are the pearls.
Wait a bit and I'll get them sewn on.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What are these? Color pencils?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
They're chalk pens for marking fabric.
Didn't you use those in your home economics class?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm, maybe?
I don't remember much from it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: At my current school, home ec is mostly about cooking.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh, so you cook at night?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you're always pushing chores onto your brother. Do you have him do the cooking assignments for you too?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can do that much myself!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, that's enough teasing you for now. I've got to focus on narrowing the sleeves. I'll put a string through here and tie it like a ribbon...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'll add some lace to the blouse, too... Oh, I have some left over. Could use this to make flower decorations for the hat...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, I'm finished!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow, that was quick!
I'm still eating my sandwich.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm an expert at this sort of thing♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, take a look! Isn't it nice?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow! It's adorable!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Told you!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're so talented at modding clothes!
It wouldn't look out of place on the shelves of a fancy store!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thank you, thank you!
I soak up praise like a sponge!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, and when you post a new photo of this outfit on your social media account...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Make sure to mention you got it modified for you by your super cute, super helpful, super nice friend♪
